rows.name: Telecommunication Equipment Type
rows.condition: IF XTN.3 NOT VALUED AND XTN.4 NOT VALUED
rows.comment: This element became required in v2.7, before that, it was optional. FHIR has a requirement that system be populated when a value is present. If the source v2 message does not contain an Equipment Type, a default system may be selected based on other information in the XTN instance (eg, if XTN.4 is valued, then the Equipment Type should default to "email). However, if neither XTN.3 nor XTN.4 are valued then it is unclear what the ContactPoint.system would be, thus the data absent reason would clearly indicate it is "unknown".
